hook: A frontier LLM generating one token requires a full forward pass over billions of parameters. That forward pass is massively over-provisioned: most of the time a much smaller model can guess the next 3-5 tokens correctly, and the big model only needs to *verify* the guess. When the guess is right you got 5 tokens for the price of one. Speculative decoding (Leviathan et al. 2023) made this exact, and EAGLE-3 (2025) pushed acceptance rates to ~4.5 tokens per verify — a 4-5x speedup at matched output distribution.
